instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Managed IT services provider offering helpdesk, network management, cybersecurity monitoring, and cloud migration services to 150+ SME clients. 24/7 NOC with 18 technicians. Currently developing a self-service client portal for ticket tracking and automated health reporting. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.

fields.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Develop Proactive Digital Advisory Services (Carry-Forward)
opportunities.rationale: The previous focus on managed services is insufficient given market disruption. This opportunity evolves the core relationship by positioning Aether not just as a service provider, but as a proactive digital transformation advisor to help SMEs navigate decline. This requires formalizing expertise and shifting billing models from time/service consumption to value/outcomes.

first_actions: Identify 3-5 high-value client profiles (e.g., specialized manufacturing, healthcare) within the SME base for pilot programs.
Develop standardized assessment frameworks and playbooks for common digital pain points outside of core networking/helpdesk.
Train technical staff on consultative selling and strategic business process mapping.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increased average client contract value by 25% within 12 months.
milestones: Pilot advisory service implemented with first paying client in Q3.
Creation of the internal Advisory Service Catalog.

opportunities.title: Productize Core Services into SaaS Offerings (New)
opportunities.rationale: Given the structural decline of traditional IT services, Aether must decouple its revenue from human labor. By productizing elements of the self-service portal and monitoring capabilities (e.g., automated health reports), they can create a scalable Minimum Viable Product (MVP) that appeals to SMEs across multiple markets without direct intervention.

first_actions: Isolate and document the core logic/data feeds for 'Automated Health Reporting' functionality.
Develop basic UI/UX wrapper around existing monitoring APIs, simulating a standalone SaaS product experience.
Pilot pricing model with 3 friendly clients to test willingness-to-pay.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10 paying subscribers to the MVP SaaS product within 6 months.
milestones: Initial beta launch of self-contained reporting dashboard (Q4).

next_steps.action: Formalize the advisory service structure and identify key internal experts for Opp_1.
Scope technical requirements and API access needed to launch the MVP SaaS product for Opp_2.
Implement structured processes for capturing customer feedback (e.g., quarterly business reviews) to feed the advisory models.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on individual technical expertise, limiting scalable process knowledge transfer (Talent risk).
Insufficient structured mechanism for capturing and quantifying customer pain points beyond informal conversations.
Difficulty allocating resources: Innovation efforts are constantly competing with the urgent need to maintain high operational efficiency.

improvements: Successful deployment and utilization of new CRM system across sales, stabilizing core data processes.
Development of self-service client portal is underway, demonstrating commitment to digital self-sufficiency.
Clear strategic pivot identified towards diversification and finding adjacent value propositions.
persistent_gaps: Lack of dedicated time/staffing bandwidth for non-revenue generating R&D activities (Time barrier).
The operational structure still treats innovation as an 'afterthought' rather than a primary revenue stream.
Limited standardized process documentation for complex client solutions.
achieved_milestones: CRM system fully adopted by the sales team.
Self-service portal development past initial wireframing phase and entering core function building.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Market pressure increased significantly (major competitor entry), necessitating a shift from incremental improvement focus to aggressive diversification and new revenue stream creation.
